Hamza ki aan jafare taiyar ki wafa
Khaibar me ban ke haidere karrar ki wafa
Karbobala ke dasht me aya kuch is tarha
Chamka ye ban ke shaye ke alamdar ki wafa
Khursheed ban ke chum raha hai ye asman

Taqdeer ka dhani hai wo jisko mila hai ye
Har wakht ke yazid ki khatir qaza hai ye
Koshish hazar kar le zamane ki sazishe
Fatwo se mufitiyo ke bhala kab jhuka hai ye
Karta hai unka aj bhi chehra dhuwan dhuwan

Ahele nefaq hmko na kar paenge fanah
Zulmo sitam na tod sake apna haosla
Zahera ki ham duwa hai hamara naseeb hai
Wirde zaban ho nade Ali ka to dar hai kya
Rakkhega dur hamse balaon ki andhiyan
Alam Abbas ka - 4
Sine me daghe matame Sarwar liye huwe
Ashke aza ke sath gaohar liye huwe
Hampe karam rahega rasule anam ka
Kuch log honge apna mukaddar liye huwe
Maihshar ki tez dhoop me dega hame aman

Har be qarar dil ka sahara alam raha
Har dubte huwe ka kinara alama raha
Aoro ne deen bech ke duniya kharidli
Faqo me hamko jan se pyara alam raha
Hargiz na kar sakega juda hamse ye jnhan
Alam Abbas ka – 4
Aye kibriya duwa ho ye manzar ki mustujab
Jab ho daher me jalwa numa ibne buturab
Labbaik ya imam ho meri zuban par
Karle wo jan nisaro me mera bhi intekhab
Kabe se jab baland kare sahe bazzman
Alam Abbas ka – 4
Bazu jo kat ke ran me alamdar ke gire
Danto se apne mashk ko thama diler ne
Nagah ek teer laga aa ke mashk par
Pani zami pe bahe gaya nazro ke samne
Aya zami pe mashk ke hamrah khufeshan
Alam Abbas ka – 4
Duba huwa lahu me alam laye ran se shah
Khaime me dekhti hai Sakina chacha ki rah
Ek pal suwe forar se hatti na thi nigah
Dekha jo tashna kam ne nikli jigar se ahh
Baba lahu bhara jo alam sath lae hain
Ammu ko mere ran me knhan chod aye hain
Abbas – 4
Shaih ne utha ke god me bachhi ko kiya pyar
Rona na meri jan ye baba tere nisar
Tumko hai kitni der se ammu ka intezar
Maktal me so raha hai Sakina wo dilfegar
Jngah me ajal use lori suna gai
Beta tere chacha ko wahan nind aa gai
Abbas - 4
Jab ye khabar suni ke alamadar mar gaya
Pani pilae kaon ke saqqa guzar gaya
Kuze zami pe tashnalabo ke bikhar gae
Tuti haram ki aas wo be aas kar gaya
Bachho ke sath ho gaya ghazi ka nauha khan
